author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Sometimes Hollywood can't get out of it's own way.  Sometimes fan favorite movie franchises become such cash cows, major film studios just rubber stamp any sequel attempt to bring in more money.  

But these ventures into the soulless side of franchise filmmaking often result in the downfall of some of your favorite franchises.  

Series like the Men in Black, Kingsman, and basically Judd Apatow's self made genre/franchise, have all backslid into embarrassing attempts to recapture the golden years.   

When will people learn it's not just a movie title we show up for?  We need compelling characters, story, and a continuation of what we fell in love with in the first place.  The franchise fatigue is real...
